text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? You won way too many of these!
If I send all of 'em to the little ones,
our tiny house is gonna be even more cramped!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, she'd definitely love it.
'Look at all the dollies!' she'd say..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Trainer.
Hold this for me, will ya?
Then take a picture.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna show the little ones.
Tell 'em this nice guy got us a whole bunch of plushies as presents."
